name: ForMind
storyline: You play as Marcus Holt, a lone scientist waking up in the crumbling corridors of Zirotech classified facility for deep-sea experimentation. A catastrophic event has wiped out the crew, life support is failing, and the darkness hides mutated horrors: the results of failed tests. Explore multi-level sections, from laboratories filled with specimen jars and monitors to rusty engineering bays, flooded halls where water reaches the ceiling, and claustrophobic ventilation shafts. The atmosphere is psychologically oppressive: the distant echoes of thuds against the hull, the drip of water, flickering emergency lights, and hallucinations brought on by stress and oxygen deprivation. The story unfolds non-linearly through logs, audio recordings, and interactive terminals. You must uncover the cause of the disaster while fighting for your life.
summary: Formind is a hardcore third-person survival horror with RPG elements, set within the collapsing underwater complex Zirotech. Waking from cryosleep with amnesia, you find yourself trapped on a station swarming with monsters that don't just kill—they learn. Every mistake you make makes them stronger, and every victory demands a new tactic. In the crushing abyss of the ocean, your survival depends on one thing: can you adapt faster than the shadows hunting you?
